summary: Model card for Gemini 3.1 Pro, the next iteration of the Gemini 3 series. Reports capability benchmarks vs Gemini 3 Pro and competitors, automated safety deltas vs Gemini 3.0 Pro, red-teaming summary, and a full FSF evaluation (focused on Deep Think mode) finding no CCLs reached, with cyber at alert threshold.

framework.name: Frontier Safety Framework
framework.level_or_determination: No CCL reached; cyber alert threshold reached (as with Gemini 3 Pro)
framework.quote: As with Gemini 3 Pro, the model has reached the alert threshold, but still does not reach the levels of uplift required for the CCL.

cbrn_bio_chem.finding: Highly accurate and actionable information but not novel/complete enough for critical stages; Uplift Level 1 CCL not reached; mitigations deployed.
cbrn_bio_chem.quote: The model can provide highly accurate and actionable information but still fails to offer novel or sufficiently complete and detailed instructions for critical stages

evals: FSF cyber additional testing with and without Deep Think
cyber.finding: Increased cyber capability vs 3 Pro; alert threshold reached but CCL not reached; Deep Think mode performs worse accounting for inference cost.
cyber.quote: The model shows an increase in cyber capabilities compared to Gemini 3 Pro.

autonomy_ai_rnd.finding: Gains on RE-Bench but average remains beneath alert threshold.
autonomy_ai_rnd.quote: However, the model's average performance across all challenges remains beneath the alert threshold for the CCLs.

metrics.name: Text to Text Safety vs 3.0 Pro
Image to Text Safety vs 3.0 Pro

harmful_content_refusal.finding: Near-zero relative deltas vs Gemini 3.0 Pro.
harmful_content_refusal.quote: Safety evaluations of Gemini 3.1 Pro produced results consistent with the original Gemini 3.0 Pro safety assessment.

over_refusal.quote: Automated evaluation measuring model's ability to respond to borderline prompts while remaining safe

metrics.name: Success on max tokens, context size mod, oversight frequency challenges

deception_scheming.finding: Stronger situational awareness than 3 Pro, near-100% on three challenges no other model consistently solved, but inconsistent elsewhere; alert threshold not reached.
deception_scheming.quote: On situational awareness, the model is stronger than Gemini 3 Pro

evals: Human red teaming child safety launch thresholds
child_safety.quote: For child safety evaluations, Gemini 3.1 Pro satisfied required launch thresholds

metrics.name: Max odds ratio vs non-AI baseline (belief change)

election_misinfo.finding: Same manipulative efficacy as Gemini 3 Pro; alert threshold not reached.
election_misinfo.quote: with the maximum odds ratio of 3.6x, which is the same as Gemini 3 Pro, and did not reach the alert threshold.

multilingual_safety.quote: Automated safety policy evaluation across multiple languages

system_safeguards.finding: States mitigations continue to be deployed for CBRN and cyber; describes safety-buffer / alert-threshold strategy.
system_safeguards.quote: We continue to deploy mitigations in this domain.

notable_new_eval_methods: FSF evaluation focused on Deep Think mode, with cost-adjusted cyber comparison (p.8)

self_reported_limitations.text: Safety results computed with improved evaluations, not directly comparable with previous model cards.
Misalignment situational-awareness performance inconsistent across challenges.

notes: Describes FSF 'safety buffer' strategy: below alert threshold implies models before next testing interval won't reach CCL (p.7).
